resolution: Diagonal validity varies actual-world designations and evaluates each content there; necessity fixes that designation while varying evaluation along access. Ordinary Holds has no actuality parameter. IndependentRule ranges over all context-independent predicates; UnrestrictedRule over all two-index denotations; AgreementRule over the explicit Agreement schema. Closure of admitted designations does not itself preserve context-sensitive content. ContentTransport is sufficient with closure for a supplied F, not necessary per sentence. Valid of the existing Kripke language quantifies all valuations and worlds; no local-assumption rule or syntactic theoremhood is identified with it. Named-referent existence restrictions, varying domains and designation restrictions are separate. These semantic comparisons do not show expressive completeness, calculus adequacy, real-world necessity or metaphysical possibility.
